proofs.text: Run the status report on a project with no spec files; verify the text carries `No specs found` and names `purlin:init`

reasons: PROOF-24 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A project with no specs under `specs/` says what to run instead of printing an empty table

tests.body:
def test_an_empty_project_says_what_to_run(self):
        made = Project(spec=None)
        try:
            text = purlin_status.sync_status(made.root)
            assert 'No specs found' in text and 'purlin:init' in text
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_an_empty_project_says_what_to_run
